spec_refs: CLAUDE.md: Docker images <= 500 MB, no apt/sudo
ARCHITECTURE §3.8 R-DB-1 PG >= 18.6 / 17.11; PG19 gated; R-DB-5 server-version gate at connect; Valkey CVE-2025-67733
oracles: ci/engines.sh self-test: refuses an image whose `docker image inspect` size > 500 MB (fake inspect fixture); refuses a server whose reported version is below the pin floor (fake version fixture)

acceptance.cmd: ci/engines.sh self-test && ci/engines.sh with pg17,pg18,pg19rc1,valkey,redis -- ci/engines.sh versions
acceptance.must: PASS; every engine starts on a loopback port, reports a version matching supply-chain/engine-pins.toml, and is torn down (no container left)

notes: `ci/engines.sh with <names> -- <cmd...>` starts throwaway containers on free 127.0.0.1 ports, substitutes argument tokens @<name> with the DSN/URL, runs cmd, always tears down. Images (all <= 500 MB): postgres:17-alpine and postgres:18-alpine (~270-290 MB; Debian postgres:17 454 MB also fits), postgres:19rc1 (461 MB, already local; the only PG19 image here), valkey/valkey:alpine (45 MB), redis:alpine (119 MB). Pin digests, not tags. engine-pins.toml: sqlite 3.53.2 (floor 3.51.3), pg17 floor 17.11, pg18 floor 18.6, pg19 blocked, valkey/redis floors from the CVE-2025-67733 advisory (look up; do not guess). Docker-only: gates using it run locally, never remote.
